Job Description 
 
 
 Overview 
 
 AtkinsRéalis is one of Canada's largest private sector nuclear engineering groups. We have been providing a wide range of services to the nuclear industry in Canada and around the world since for more than 60 years. We are proud to be the steward of Canadian CANDU nuclear technology.
 
 The Data & Integration Developer, reporting directly to the Director, AI & Automation, will be responsible for developing and supporting system integrations and helping establish the organization’s enterprise data platform. The role will work with business and technology stakeholders to connect applications, improve the movement and quality of data, and make trusted information available for reporting, analytics, automation and AI initiatives.   
 
 Your role 
 
 Design, configure, test, deploy and support integrations between enterprise applications, databases and data sources using platforms such as DataBridge Pro and Microsoft Azure Logic Apps. 
 Develop and maintain integration workflows using APIs, database connections, messaging, secure file transfer and other appropriate integration patterns. 
 Build data transformation, validation, routing, reconciliation and error-handling processes to support reliable information exchange between systems. 
 Assist in establishing and evolving an enterprise data warehouse and data platform that consolidates information from business, engineering and operational systems. 
 Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, curated datasets and data models for reporting, analytics, automation and AI use cases. 
 Work with business stakeholders, application owners and technical teams to define interface, data and reporting requirements. 
 Analyze source-system data structures, business rules and data quality issues, and recommend practical solutions. 
 Apply appropriate security, access, governance, data quality, lineage and retention requirements to integration and data solutions. 
 Monitor production integrations and data pipelines, investigate failures, resolve defects and support ongoing operational reliability. 
 Prepare and maintain solution documentation, including interface specifications, data mappings, architecture diagrams, operating procedures and support runbooks. 
 Participate in solution testing, deployment planning, change management and the transition of new capabilities into operation. 
 Contribute to reusable integration patterns, technical standards and continuous improvement of the organization’s data and integration practices. 
 Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. 
 
 About you 
 
 University Degree or College Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 5+ years of experience developing and supporting system integrations, data pipelines, enterprise applications or data platforms. 
 Demonstrated experience designing, implementing and supporting production integrations using an enterprise integration platform such as Microsoft Azure Logic Apps, DataBridge Pro, Apache NiFi, or a comparable technology. 
 Strong experience working with REST APIs, JSON, XML, SQL, relational databases and secure file-based integrations. 
 Practical experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines, data models and data warehouse or modern data platform solutions. 
 Experience with Microsoft Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, Power BI or comparable technologies is preferred. 
 Experience with source control, testing, deployment pipelines, monitoring and technical documentation is an asset. 
 Knowledge of authentication, authorization, service accounts, certificates and secure system-to-system connectivity. 
 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational and interpersonal skills. 
 Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to work with both business and technical stakeholders. 
 Understanding of engineering design processes and an appreciation of the importance of Quality Assurance Programs in the nuclear industry; nuclear industry experience is an asset. 
 
 Rewards & benefits 
 
 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.
 Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.
 Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.
 And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.
 Be rewarded. Find out more. 
 
 About AtkinsRéalis 
 
 We're AtkinsRéalis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
 Find out more. 
 
 Additional information 
 
 AtkinsRéalis cares about your privacy. AtkinsRéalis and other subsidiary or affiliated companies of AtkinsRéalis (referred to throughout as “AtkinsRéalis”) are committed to protecting your privacy. Please consult our  Privacy Notice  on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer your Personal Data.
 By submitting your personal information to AtkinsRéalis, you confirm that you have read and accept our Privacy Notice.
 
 Appropriate accommodation will be provided upon request throughout the recruitment and hiring process as required by Company policy and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). 
 
 Successful applicants will be notified about AtkinsRéalis’ accommodation policies at the time the employment offer is extended, and the information will be shared with new personnel during the onboarding process.
